name: Omarchy acceptance builder
postCreateCommand:
sudo mkdir -p /etc/containers && printf '[storage]
driver="overlay"
graphroot="/builds/containers"
runroot="/run/containers/storage"
' | sudo tee /etc/containers/storage.conf >/dev/null && printf '[engine]
cgroup_manager="cgroupfs"
events_logger="file"
' | sudo tee /etc/containers/containers.conf >/dev/null
